label: 19–23 October
notes: Cook in this order: fish and prawns first while they're freshest.
Breakfast is the same every day. Prep the jars the night before.
Nutrition is estimated per serving from ingredient weights.

breakfast.title: Berry, chia & almond protein yoghurt bowl
steps: Night before (best): split the yoghurt between 2 jars or bowls, stir 30g oats and 10g chia into each, top with 80g frozen berries each and refrigerate. The berries thaw into a sauce overnight.
Same-morning option: microwave the berries for 60–90 sec, then stir the oats and chia into the yoghurt.
Top each bowl with 10g chopped almonds and eat.
breakfast.tip: Make 3 jars on Sunday night (Mon–Wed) and 2 on Wednesday night (Thu–Fri). The oats soften and the chia thickens it, so it's grab-and-go.

dinners.title: Honey-tamari salmon, rice, tenderstem & edamame

ingredients.item: Tilda basmati, dry. Half is for Tuesday

steps: Rinse 200g rice and simmer in plenty of water for 11 min, then drain. Keep half for tonight. Spread the other half on a plate to cool, then refrigerate within 1 hour for Tuesday.
Mix the tamari, honey and garlic.
Air Fryer: salmon skin-side down at 200°C for 9–10 min. Brush with half the glaze at 5 min.
Boil the tenderstem for 4 min, adding the edamame for the last 2 min. Drain.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the greens. Spoon over the rest of the glaze and finish with spring onion and a squeeze of lime.
dinners.tip: Weigh the rice dry. 50g dry per person is what keeps this under 600 kcal.

dinners.title: Chilli-lime prawn burrito bowls
steps: Toss the prawns with the oil, paprika, cumin, chilli, the zest of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Air Fryer: 200°C for 6–7 min, shaking halfway, until pink all through.
Salsa: chop the tomatoes, onion and half the coriander. Mix with the juice of ½ lime and a pinch of salt.
Reheat the rice with a splash of water for 2 min, until piping hot. Warm the beans with a pinch of cumin.
Build the bowls: rice, beans, shredded lettuce, prawns, salsa, sliced avocado, a spoon of yoghurt and lime wedges.
dinners.tip: Freeze the other half tin of beans in a small box, ready for another bowl.

dinners.title: Chicken shawarma quinoa bowls with garlic-mint yoghurt
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in 200ml water, covered, for 12–15 min. Rest it off the heat.
Toss the chicken with half the oil, the spices, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Toss the peppers and onion with the rest of the oil.
Air Fryer: veg at 200°C for 8 min, then add the chicken and cook for 14–16 min more, turning halfway, until cooked through.
Sauce: yoghurt, grated garlic, chopped mint and a pinch of salt. Salad: dice the cucumber and tomatoes and dress with lemon and salt.
Slice the chicken and build the bowls: quinoa, veg, chicken, salad and a spoon of sauce.
dinners.tip: Keep the rest of the mint wrapped in damp kitchen roll for Friday.

dinners.title: Italian beef & lentil stuffed aubergine

ingredients.item: lean beef mince 5% (from the freezer, defrosted)

steps: Halve the aubergine lengthways, score the flesh, brush with 1 tsp oil and salt. Air Fryer: cut-side up at 190°C for 15 min, until soft.
Meanwhile, brown the mince in the rest of the oil for 5 min. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 min.
Stir in the garlic, oregano, chilli and tomato paste for 1 min. Add the tomatoes, rinsed lentils and 200ml water. Simmer, covered, for 20 min, until the lentils are tender.
Scoop out some aubergine flesh, chop it and stir it into the ragù. Pile the ragù into the aubergine halves.
Air Fryer: 190°C for 5 min. Serve with any extra ragù on the side.
dinners.tip: Take the mince out of the freezer on Wednesday night and defrost it in the fridge.

dinners.title: Lemongrass chicken bún with herbs & nuoc cham
steps: Mix the chicken with the lemongrass paste, tamari, 1 tsp honey and the oil. Leave for 10 min.
Air Fryer: 200°C for 14–16 min, turning halfway, until charred and cooked through.
Cover the vermicelli with boiling water for 5 min, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Nuoc cham: mix the fish sauce, lime juice, 1 tsp honey, grated garlic, chilli and 3 tbsp water.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into thin sticks, shred the lettuce and pick the herbs. Build the bowls: noodles, veg, herbs, sliced chicken and almonds, then spoon over the nuoc cham.
dinners.tip: Take the chicken out of the freezer on Thursday night and defrost it in the fridge.

tips: Split the chicken thighs into 2 × 300g. Fridge one for Wednesday (check the use-by, and freeze it too if it's before Wednesday). Freeze the other for Friday.
Freeze all the beef mince: one 300g bag for Thursday and 3 × 150g bags for future weeks. Label them.
Make 3 breakfast jars for Monday to Wednesday.
Cook 200g rice once. Tuesday's half goes in the fridge within an hour of cooking, and gets reheated once only, until piping hot.
Wrap the coriander and mint in damp kitchen roll in a box. They're used Tue, Wed and Fri.
Make 2 more breakfast jars for Thursday and Friday.
Move Thursday's mince from the freezer to the fridge.
Move Friday's chicken from the freezer to the fridge.
Edamame: 80g goes in Monday's dinner. The rest of the bag is a snack: microwave it and add a pinch of salt.
Little gems: one Tuesday, one Friday. Cucumber: half Wednesday, half Friday. Limes: Monday, Tuesday and Friday.
Freeze the leftover half tin of black beans. The spare pepper and cherry tomatoes make a snack with Babybel.
Lentils, quinoa, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste and fish sauce all come from your cupboard.
